plan.kind: Fixed 4K performance regression rerun on freshly fetched latest main; historical prompts reused, no new workload-independence claim.
plan.machine: Mac mini2024, Apple M4,10GPU cores,24GiB; macOS26.5.2(25F84),SDK26.2
plan.primary: Loaded-model native HTTP TTFT after fixed warmup and completed ANE preparation. Analyze paired log(A/B) per workload.
plan.secondary: Complete512-token HTTP request time, eligible only when telemetry for the whole request passes. Continuations may differ; no same-work decode speed claim.
plan.eligibility: Two or more1s samples overlapping each phase with no gap>2.5s; non-owned GPU including WindowServer mean<=1%, peak<=2%; nominal thermal; HID idle>=300s; zero phase swapouts using the preceding sample/pre-run counter. Exactly512nonempty tokens, finish=length, no native invalid flags, cached_tokens=0.
plan.retries: Only TTFT-telemetry-rejected workload pairs are repeated, once, both A and B. Use the first eligible attempt; retain every first/retry result. No retries based on speed. Idle-gate timeout stops the schedule as incomplete.
plan.failure: Stop for invalid output, wrong path, unexpected ANE fallback or request mismatch. Fewer than3eligible pairs per workload is inconclusive.
plan.analysis: Paired geometric A/B ratio and two-sided95% Student-t confidence interval of log ratios per workload. Confirmation requires>=3pairs and lowerCI>1 for both4Kworkloads; all first attempts retained as sensitivity. No early stopping.
plan.controls: Immutable current-main/current-integration binaries, exclusive GPU lock,8s quiet gate, no builds/downloads/CPU suites, one slot, fresh KAPITSA_HOME and disk cacheoff; matching A/B requests and budgets. CPU contention checked before launch.
plan.flags_A: Default current-main server flags; no NI_ overrides.
plan.flags_B: Same flags plus NI_ANE_H4096=1; default DFlash, default async ANE, default units, context32768.
plan.display: User explicitly authorized display sleep for performance. Keep system awake, preserve unrelated apps/processes. Record control before launch.
plan.scope: New focused4Krerun only. Does not turn the historical failed four-workload/16K protocol into a pass. No16Kperformance or broad quality claim.
